sloka: समानिनाय मेदिन्याः प्रधानान् पृथिवीपतीन् ।न तु केकयराजानं जनकं वा नराधिपः ॥२-१-४६॥
transliteration: samānināya medinyāḥ pradhānān pṛthivīpatīn ।na tu kekayarājānaṁ janakaṁ vā narādhipaḥ ॥2-1-46॥

translations.english: The king did not invite both the kings of Kekaya and Janaka in haste with an intention that they would hear the glad news at a later date.
